description: Looks up a word in Polidict's public dictionary and returns meanings, translations and examples. It reads only the public catalog, never the learner's saved words, and changes nothing. A miss returns no entries.

languageCode.description: Code of the learning language, for example en-GB or es-ES.

translationLanguageCode.description: Code of the language for translations, for example uk-UA. Defaults to the signed-in learner's native language.

name: lookup_dictionary_word
title: Look up a word
